description.en: The unique identifier of the workspace. For more information, see [AgentKey](~~2587494~~).

description.zh:
任务唯一标识
> TaskId默认无需填写，系统将自动生成。当后续任务填写的TaskId相同时，表示这些任务属于同一组对话。
>
description.en:
The unique identifier of the task.

> This parameter is optional. The system automatically generates a task ID if you do not specify this parameter. Tasks that have the same \`TaskId\` belong to the same conversation group.
